```{r cars}
library(dada2)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)
```

## Load the data

```{r}

#Phyloseq object
zotu97 <- import_qiime("../p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")
original <- zotu97

#Metadata
metadata <- read.csv("../metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$pot <-interaction(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))

#Fasta file
fasta_file <- "../p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97.fa"
seqs <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_file)

#UNITE database
unite_ref <- "sh_general_release_dynamic_19.02.2025.fasta"


```


## Taxonomy assignment
```{r}
head(names(seqs))
set.seed(5070)
tax_assign <- assignTaxonomy(seqs, refFasta = unite_ref,
                             multithread = TRUE, tryRC = TRUE, minBoot = 50)
rownames(tax_assign) <- names(seqs)
saveRDS(tax_assign, file= "taxonomy_ITS_dada2.RDa")


```


## Merge the new tax assignment to phyloseq
```{r}
tax_table(zotu97) <- tax_table(tax_assign)
```



# Prepare plots to compare

## DADA2 Assignment

```{r}
# Turn into rel abund.
norm.dada<-  transform_sample_counts(zotu97, function(x) x / sum(x) )
tax.dada <- tax_table(norm.dada) %>% data.frame()
tax.sintax <- tax_table(original) %>% data.frame()

#Compare to Syntax
perc.NA <- data.frame("DADA2"= round(colSums(is.na(tax_table(norm.dada)))/nrow(tax.dada)*100,2),
                      "Syntax"= round(colSums(is.na(tax_table(original)))/nrow(tax_table(original))*100,2))

```
